en: In the morning, my dad woke up early. We went to the river later and waited for the race. Then the judge counted down and the race began! I ran and cheered for my dad. His boat was very fast. Finally, his team won the race! They all sang their team song together. They were so happy!
zh: 早上，爸爸很早就起床了。后来我们去了河边，等待比赛开始。接着裁判开始倒计时，比赛开始了！我跑着为爸爸加油助威。他的船速非常快。最终，他的队伍赢得了比赛！他们一起唱起了队歌。他们太高兴了！

en: In the evening, our family made zongzi and had a big dinner for the festival, and for the winner, my dad! It was the best Dragon Boat Festival ever!
zh: 晚上，我们全家包了粽子，为这个节日，也为获胜的爸爸举办了一场盛大的晚宴！这是有史以来最棒的端午节！

en: The Story of Nian
zh: 年的故事

en: Scene 1
zh: 第一幕

en: Narrator: One night, an old man came to a village. He saw the local people running away.
zh: 旁白：一天夜里，一位老人来到一个村庄。他看到当地的村民们正在四处逃跑。

en: Old man: Excuse me, why are you running? What happened?
zh: 老人：打扰一下，你们为什么要跑？发生了什么事？

en: Villager: The monster Nian will come! Last year, it ate many animals. We are all afraid of it.
zh: 村民：怪兽"年"要来了！去年，它吃了许多动物。我们都很害怕它。

en: Old man: Wait! I have a good idea. I can help you!
zh: 老人：等等！我有一个好主意。我能帮助你们！

en: Villager: The monster is very strong. You should run away to the mountains with us!
zh: 村民：这个怪兽非常强大。你应该和我们一起逃到山里去！

en: Old man: No. I will stay alone in the village and face Nian.
zh: 老人：不。我会独自留在村子里面对"年"。

en: Scene 2
zh: 第二幕

en: Narrator: The old man stayed in the village. Then, at midnight, the monster came.
zh: 旁白：老人留在了村子里。然后，在午夜时分，怪兽来了。

en: Nian: What is that red paper on the doors and windows? I hate the colour red! Why are the windows so bright? I hate bright lights!
zh: 年：门窗上贴的是什么红色的纸？我讨厌红色！为什么窗户这么亮？我讨厌强光！

en: Old man: Aha! He looks worried.
zh: 老人：啊哈！它看起来很担心。

en: Narrator: Then the old man set off fireworks. Bang! Bang! Bang!
zh: 旁白：然后老人点燃了烟花。砰！砰！砰！

en: Nian: Oh no! I hate loud noises! No, no!
zh: 年：不好了！我讨厌巨大的声响！不，不要！

en: Scene 3
zh: 第三幕

en: Narrator: Nian was very afraid and ran back to the sea. The next day, the villagers came back to the village.
zh: 旁白："年"非常害怕，跑回了大海。第二天，村民们回到了村子里。

en: Villager 1: I can't believe it! All our animals are safe!
zh: 村民一：真不敢相信！我们所有的动物都平安无事！

en: Villager 2: How did you do it?
zh: 村民二：你是怎么做到的？

en: Old man: Last night, I pasted red paper on the doors and windows and I also lit many candles. Finally, I set off fireworks. He ran away!
zh: 老人：昨晚，我在门窗上贴了红纸，还点了许多蜡烛。最后，我放了烟花。它就跑走了！

en: Villagers: Hooray! We are safe!
zh: 村民们：万岁！我们得救了！

en: Narrator: From then on, on New Year's Eve, people get together to celebrate the coming new year. They paste fu and Spring Festival couplets on their doors and set off fireworks. This is why the Spring Festival is also called guonian.
zh: 旁白：从那以后，每逢除夕，人们便聚在一起庆祝新年的到来。他们在门上贴福字和春联，并燃放烟花。这就是为什么春节也被称为"过年"的原因。
✅ 参考答案示例

en: Why is the Spring Festival also called guonian? Because from then on, people get together on New Year's Eve to celebrate the coming new year. They paste fu and Spring Festival couplets on their doors and set off fireworks, just like the old man did to scare Nian away.
zh: 春节为什么也叫"过年"？ 因为从那时起，人们每逢除夕便聚在一起庆祝新年。他们在门上贴福字和春联，燃放烟花，就像那位老人赶走"年"时所做的那样。

en: What did the old man do to scare Nian away? He pasted red paper on the doors and windows, lit many candles and set off fireworks. Nian hated the colour red, bright lights and loud noises, so it ran away.
zh: 那位老人做了什么来吓走"年"？ 他在门窗上贴了红纸，点了许多蜡烛，还燃放了烟花。"年"讨厌红色、强光和巨大的声响，所以它就逃走了。
